shots.narration: If an empty wooden boat drifts downriver and bumps against your skiff, you feel nothing.

shots.end_visual: The empty boat drifts gently into the side of a moored skiff with a soft wooden thud, floating harmlessly beside it.
shots.subject_motion: the empty wooden boat glides smoothly through river mist and taps gently against the stationary skiff
